Exercises worked through during the weekly meet-up for **ISSS626: Geospatial
Analytics and Applications** at Singapore Management University. These run shorter
than the hands-on exercises and focus on interpretation rather than full coverage of
a method.

::: {.coursework-group}

::: {.coursework-group-header}
<span class="coursework-number">05</span>
<span class="coursework-group-title">In-class Exercise 5</span>
:::

<p class="coursework-group-desc">Emerging Hot Spot Analysis on Hunan GDP per capita,
2005 to 2021. Builds a space-time cube with <code>sfdep</code>, computes the local
Gi* statistic at each time slice, and classifies each county by the Mann-Kendall
trend in its hotspot series.</p>
